page_title: SPA 1-1 GER | Spain v Germany 27/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) launches a cross from the corner, but Unai Simon is alert to thwart the effort.

90+5' Leroy Sane (Germany) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Germany will take a corner.
90+3' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Joshua Kimmich (Germany) sends it out of play.
90+2' Dani Olmo (Spain) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Spain take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' The ball is cleared after Alvaro Morata (Spain) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Spain can continue in their attacking effort.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) coming on for David Raum.
85' Today's match ends for Serge Gnabry who will be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Germany).
83' 1 - 1 After a goalmouth scramble the ball rebounds out to Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) who buries it from close range into the roof of the net.
82' Here is a change. Jordi Alba is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Balde (Spain).
81' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
81' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block. The referee blows his whistle, Germany are awarded a corner kick.

80' It looks like Rodri (Spain) saw red with that tackle. Danny Makkelie won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Germany win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
80' The attendance for today's match is 68895.
79' Leroy Sane (Germany) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
79' Sergio Busquets (Spain) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
75' The linesman signals that Alvaro Morata (Spain) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 11:11.
74' Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
74' Germany get a corner.

73' Jamal Musiala (Germany) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
73' Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thilo Kehrer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (Germany).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) replaces Thomas Muller.
70' Here comes a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan is given a rest as he is replaced by Leroy Sane (Germany).
66' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Gavi is replaced by Nico Williams (Spain).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marco Asensio will be replaced by Koke (Spain).
65' Marco Asensio (Spain) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
64' Leon Goretzka (Germany) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
64' David Raum (Germany) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

62' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Jordi Alba, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Alvaro Morata (Spain), who beats Manuel Neuer with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 1:0.
62' Dani Olmo (Spain) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
61' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Gavi (Spain) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) has tested the patience of referee Danny Makkelie and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' David Raum (Germany) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
59' The ball is laid off to Dani Olmo (Spain) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Manuel Neuer to make a decent save.
58' Leon Goretzka (Germany) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
57' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Germany) is cleared by the defence.
56' Great save! Joshua Kimmich (Germany) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Unai Simon.
54' Substitution. Ferran Torres is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Spain).
53' Serge Gnabry (Germany) meets a cross inside the box, but Unai Simon wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Germany, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
50' Dangerous play by Sergio Busquets (Spain). Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Gavi (Spain) commits a rough foul. Danny Makkelie stops the game and makes a call.
47' Thomas Muller (Germany) is adjudged offside.
47' A pass from Marco Asensio (Spain) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dani Olmo (Spain), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45+2' Gavi (Spain) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Spain.
45+1' Antonio Rudiger (Germany) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the leftside of the goal, but Unai Simon makes a magnificent save!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Sergio Busquets (Spain) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Danny Makkelie had an easy-decision to make.
42' A quickly taken corner by Spain.
42' An attempted cross from Jordi Alba (Spain) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Spain will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Germany due to an offside in the build-up play.
40' The Germany players halt their celebrations as referee Danny Makkelie makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

40' It's in the back of the net! Joshua Kimmich flights the free kick into the box, where Antonio Rudiger (Germany) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:1.
39' The game is interrupted. Jordi Alba (Spain) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

38' Gavi (Spain) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
38' Serge Gnabry (Germany) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thilo Kehrer (Germany) was quite harsh and Danny Makkelie didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Dani Olmo (Spain) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
36' Ferran Torres (Spain) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Spain.
35' Dani Olmo (Spain) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

35' Dani Olmo (Spain) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Spain are awarded a corner kick.
34' David Raum (Germany) commits a rough challenge and Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Dani Olmo (Spain) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

30' Antonio Rudiger (Germany) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Spain will have a goal kick.
30' Rough tackle by Marco Asensio (Spain). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' David Raum (Germany) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' Rodri (Spain) makes a strong challenge and Danny Makkelie blows for a foul.
27' Ferran Torres (Spain) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
25' Serge Gnabry (Germany) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
24' Serge Gnabry (Germany) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
23' Ferran Torres (Spain) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Danny Makkelie who sees an offensive foul.

22' Fine attempt! Jordi Alba (Spain) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Germany.
20' Spain string together a series of short passes.
16' Flag goes up against Thomas Muller (Germany) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' 76:24 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
14' Leon Goretzka (Germany) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Danny Makkelie no option but to blow his whistle.
13' Dani Olmo (Spain) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Serge Gnabry (Germany) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' Spain can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

7' Dani Olmo (Spain) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and slashes the ball into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper performs an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The strike bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
5' Ferran Torres (Spain) tries to find Marco Asensio, but he puts too much power on the pass.
4' Leon Goretzka (Germany) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Danny Makkelie has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Thilo Kehrer (Germany) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
2' Marco Asensio (Spain) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Spain will have the kick-off.
Danny Makkelie was nominated as the referee for this game.
